manifest.source: Exact Antigravity CLI 1.1.12 release and executable identities, authorized print-mode/hook captures, and official documentation. Existing captures are legacy projections; their shape limitations are explicit.

argv.notes: Native process launch and session/resume selection.

print-stream.notes: Native --print --output-format stream-json records; a survey oracle, not the native TUI rail.

print-json.notes: Native --print --output-format json terminal result or local slash-command response.

hook-command.notes: Configured command hook receives one JSON document on stdin and returns one JSON document on stdout.

transcript-jsonl.notes: Observed transcript.jsonl durable record rail; SQLite and transcript_full remain distinct unmodelled candidates.

claims.harness: authorized --print json/stream-json survey with launch-scoped workspace command hooks, add-dir discovery, same-conversation resume, read-only slash commands, and successful read tools
claims.notes: The retained fixtures are legacy privacy projections. This claim proves occurrence, ordering, joins, and explicitly retained scalar/type observations, not complete native payload shape.

claims.harness: release archive identity, executable SHA-256, --version, --help, rejected-option, and static-string probes

claims.notes: Official documentation and changelog projection establish declared hook fields, callbacks, flags, and durable-path leads but are not exact source or runtime evidence.

limitations: All retained runtime fixtures are schemaVersion 1 legacy privacy projections. Their raw inputs are unavailable; future schemaVersion 2 captures preserve native JSON keys, containers, and types.
The census covers print mode and command hooks, not the native interactive TUI transport.

No file-mutating tool was forced. The tool catalog proves edit-capable tool names exist, but file paths, before/after content, and diffs are not currently observable with verified Antigravity evidence.
Transcript JSONL, transcript_full JSONL, and SQLite were observed as distinct durable candidates; only selected transcript.jsonl fields are modelled.
The public release repository does not expose binary-equivalent implementation source. The release tag is provenance only.
Only the darwin-arm64 executable has runtime evidence. Other platform records identify official archives, not executed behavior.
